Read-only inspection of its sealed .tmp build found zero exact seed JSON references and both seed JSONs absent from that isolated source snapshot. resume.md:7,69–70 records an earlier Coze deployment with the pinned tree and an unverified local build ID. The formal Coze runtime package inventory and Git-free cold-start behavior remain unverified.
